property_summary: After SetLogFile with a valid log contract, SetMinSum(0), Initialized, and a user deposits 1 wei then calls Collect(1), the reference reverts because Log.AddMessage's push causes a revert due to the LogFile contract's receive() reentrancy causing a revert, while the buggy version with Log set to address(0x123) succeeds because address(0x123) has no code, so the call silently fails and Collect completes.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to Log with a different LogFile contract address
